request: DebugAI native hypothesis evidence review handoff regression after adding tool evidence; existing owned nested worktree and offline isolated tests, no model inference

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
w="$p/.worktrees/hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028"
expected=26e06410ea6b5d2685313b3df7f8e3396c1ceb5c
[ "$(realpath "$p")" = /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai ]
[ "$(realpath "$w")" = "$w" ]
[ -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ] || { echo TEST_WORKTREE_DIRTY; exit 4; }
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/debugai-hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028
[ "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$expected" ] || { echo TEST_BRANCH_IDENTITY_CHANGED; exit 4; }
git -C "$w" checkout --detach "$expected" >/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected" ] || exit 4
image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)
echo "DEBUGAI_TEST_SOURCE=$expected"
echo TEST_SANDBOX=OFFLINE_READONLY_TMPFS
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 128 --memory 768m --cpus 1 \
 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777 \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/workflow.js,target=/app/server/workflow.js,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,target=/app/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/compose.yaml,target=/app/compose.yaml,readonly" \
 --entrypoint node "$image" \
 --test server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/external-review-verdict-contract.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-review-tool-runtime.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-diagnoser-horizontal-continuation.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-six-role-horizontal-entry.test.cjs
echo DEBUGAI_FOCUSED_TESTS=PASS
echo CREATED_NEW_TOP_LEVEL_SIBLING=NO
